email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGlutide patient with severe hypoglycemia and became unresponsive at home
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 21-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their third dose of DemoGlutide (dose: 5 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-03-11.
Approximately 10 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed severe hypoglycemia and became unresponsive at home.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
L. Duval (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter662@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
